CI_FAILURE_INVALID.reason: The CI failure input is malformed, names a non-required check, is not a failure, or came together with a remote-test receipt.
CI_FAILURE_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: pass one exact-head required check failure on its own, or none.

REMOTE_TEST_RECEIPT_INVALID.reason: The remote-test receipt is not a digest-valid FAIL for this Task, run, executor Task and head, or its excerpt is too large.
REMOTE_TEST_RECEIPT_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: rerun the EC2 remote test on the exact head and use its unmodified FAIL receipt.

REPAIR_CHAIN_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The continuation chain lock could not be taken, so no count was read and nothing was written.

REPAIR_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The repair claims are malformed, the retry claim is not a dispatched claim of this head, or the claim write failed.
REPAIR_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Inspect and reconcile the Task's repair claims and any unclaimed repair Task; never replay an UNKNOWN claim.

REPAIR_CODEX_DEVELOPER_RETIRED.reason: The Task's Developer route is Codex, which now serves only as Reviewer and AI Debug.
REPAIR_CODEX_DEVELOPER_RETIRED.pm_action: Replan the repair on a supported Developer route.

REPAIR_COUNT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: A Task record needed for the repair count could not be read, or the chain changed during the read.

REPAIR_DATA_CLASS_INVALID.reason: The gw-agent route accepts only SYNTHETIC or PUBLIC_REPO data, and the Task's data class is neither.
REPAIR_DATA_CLASS_INVALID.pm_action: Route the repair to a Developer permitted for the Task's data class; never relabel the data.

REPAIR_DEBUG_REQUIRED.reason: A further review repair needs an RCA_CONFIRMED AI Debug of this failure family on the failed head first.
REPAIR_DEBUG_REQUIRED.pm_action: Run a bounded AI Debug Task on the failed head, then decide the repair from its result.

REPAIR_DEVELOPER_BINDING_INVALID.reason: The Task's Developer binding, state, scope, goal or acceptance is missing or malformed, or the repair acceptance exceeds 16 items.
REPAIR_DEVELOPER_BINDING_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the Task's Developer binding, or replan the repair with a shorter acceptance list.

REPAIR_DEVELOPER_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.reason: The Task's Developer route cannot run a repair continuation.
REPAIR_DEVELOPER_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.pm_action: Replan the repair on a supported Developer route.

REPAIR_DISPUTE_OPEN.reason: A review dispute on this PR head is still open, so no review repair may start until it is ruled.

REPAIR_FAILED_FINAL_REQUIRED.reason: A REPLAN Task reached its review FAIL limit and ends FAILED_FINAL instead of another repair.
REPAIR_FAILED_FINAL_REQUIRED.pm_action: End the REPLAN Task as FAILED_FINAL under the repair policy.

REPAIR_FAMILY_INVALID.reason: The repair family name is malformed, too long, or ends with the reserved -ec2 suffix.
REPAIR_FAMILY_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: omit the family, or give a lowercase name of at most 64 characters without the -ec2 suffix.

REPAIR_HEAD_MOVED.reason: The registered D6 is missing, unreadable or moved, or its head is not the failed head.
REPAIR_HEAD_MOVED.pm_action: Reconcile the registered D6 and its head before any repair; a new head needs its own review.

REPAIR_LIMIT_REACHED.reason: The policy's repair or test-failure limit is used up, or the count is UNKNOWN, which counts as used up.
REPAIR_LIMIT_REACHED.pm_action: Escalate under the repair policy (split, PM decision or stop) instead of another repair.

REPAIR_LINEAGE_INVALID.reason: The Task lineage kind or the review FAIL count is invalid, so the next policy step cannot be chosen.
REPAIR_LINEAGE_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the Task's lineage record before any repair decision.

REPAIR_NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.reason: The failed verdict has no blocking finding, or an arbiter withdrew every blocking finding, so it is not a valid FAIL.
REPAIR_NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.pm_action: Do not repair; decide the head's next review step from the verdict and any dispute ruling.

REPAIR_PACKET_INVALID.reason: The repair packet built from the failure exceeds its size limit.
REPAIR_PACKET_INVALID.pm_action: Replan the repair from a bounded failure summary that fits the packet.

REPAIR_PM_DECIDE_REQUIRED.reason: A child Task reached its review FAIL limit or its group Debug is used, so the PM decides its next step.
REPAIR_PM_DECIDE_REQUIRED.pm_action: Decide the child Task at PM_DECIDE (replan, drop or stop) under the repair policy.

REPAIR_PM_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The Task has no recorded PM session or working directory to record the repair continuation under.
REPAIR_PM_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Replan the repair as a new PM-recorded Task.

REPAIR_POLICY_INVALID.reason: The repair policy file is missing, unreadable or malformed.
REPAIR_POLICY_INVALID.pm_action: Restore policy.json to its main content without changing any limit.

REPAIR_ROOT_TASK_REQUIRED.reason: The Task is itself a repair continuation; repairs are counted and run from the root Task.
REPAIR_ROOT_TASK_REQUIRED.pm_action: Run the repair from the root Task that holds the repair claims.

REPAIR_SPLIT_REQUIRED.reason: A root Task reached its review FAIL limit and splits into child Tasks instead of another repair.
REPAIR_SPLIT_REQUIRED.pm_action: Split the root Task into bounded child Tasks under the repair policy.

REPAIR_TASK_INVALID.reason: The Task record is missing or does not match the requested Task ID.
REPAIR_TASK_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: name an existing Task ID.

REPAIR_TASK_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The repair continuation Task could not be recorded or validated, and no repair claim was counted.
REPAIR_TASK_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Reconcile any recorded repair Task before deciding whether to repair again.

REVIEW_FAIL_EVENT_MISSING.reason: No pending Reviewer FAIL event with a matching formal REVIEW_FAIL verdict exists for this executor Task, PR and head.
REVIEW_FAIL_EVENT_MISSING.pm_action: Confirm the formal verdict and its recorded review result before any repair.

REVIEW_REPAIR_PM_REQUIRED.reason: The automatic path admits only a chain's first review repair, and this chain already has one or its count is in doubt.
REVIEW_REPAIR_PM_REQUIRED.pm_action: Decide the next review repair yourself under the repair policy.

REVIEW_RESULT_COMMENTS_INVALID.reason: The PR comments could not be read as a list of comment objects, or there are 100 or more.
REVIEW_RESULT_COMMENTS_INVALID.pm_action: Confirm the verdict comment on the PR, then decide the repair from a confirmed verdict.

RUNTIME_NOT_ON_PATH.reason: The Claude CLI needed for the Developer repair route is not on PATH.
